body: Liverpool is actively pursuing a France star with a reported €60m+ bid, while simultaneously considering cancelling an existing transfer deal following an agent meeting. The club remains in advanced talks for Manu Koné, with Chelsea also vying for the player, though no agreement has been reached. Interest in a new signing is high, but the status of the current transfer cancellation remains unresolved.

findings.evidence_quote: Chelsea, Liverpool could offer over €60 million to sign Manu Kone
